title: When the Autopsy Burns Revisited
author: Odile Halloran
blurb: Wren Okafor, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
